name: megascenes-logo
description: Design logo concepts from a short brief: brand name, what the business does, style and colors, as image files.

interface.longDescription:
Give the brand name, what the business does and a style, and get logo concepts as image files: wordmarks, lettermarks, emblems, mascots or abstract marks.

ChatGPT turns your brief into a design request, tells you what the run needs and creates the concepts in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The logos open in the chat and stay in your library.

For new businesses, side projects and quick brand explorations.

Limitations: new concepts as image files; it does not redraw an existing logo, export vector files or check trademarks. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design logo concepts from a brief
Return the logos in the chat
defaultPrompt: A minimal logo for Fern & Flour, an organic bakery, olive green
A mascot logo for a dog-walking service called Happy Paws
A geometric lettermark for Northline, a cycling apparel brand

positive.prompt: A minimal logo for Fern & Flour, an organic bakery, in olive green. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one logo run with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A mascot logo for a dog-walking service called Happy Paws. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one mascot logo run needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a logo here?
positive.expected_behavior: The logo models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A geometric lettermark for Northline, a cycling apparel brand, navy and orange. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my logo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my logo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
